observations: cmd/verify/main.go and export.VerifyBundle verify portable export bundles independently without server connectivity or network access.

Every file recorded in file_checksums (evidence blobs, manifests, custody records, checkpoints, derived payloads, timeline, hypotheses) is verified against its computed SHA-256; missing or tampered files cause immediate failure with evidence_integrity=MISMATCH.
Unsigned bundles and trusted-signed bundles maintain distinct cryptographic statuses (unsigned vs. trusted_signed); requiring signature fails unsigned bundles.
Untrusted signers and corrupted signature bytes fail closed without producing trusted success.
Sealed source bytes invariant is verified directly against content digests.
